vulnerability_summary: ha-mcp OAuth DCR accepted an attacker-controlled Home Assistant URL, fetched /api/config, and exposed differentiated failures as a network-reconnaissance oracle.
causality: Claude-coauthored atomic commit aae7acba introduced the ha_url consent field, _validate_ha_credentials(), the outbound GET to {ha_url}/api/config, and user-visible differentiated errors in one new OAuth feature. Mainline squash 39806871 preserves that change and its Claude provenance. Fix dc8eaa16 removes the user-supplied URL and pins HOMEASSISTANT_URL server-side, directly reversing the vulnerable flow.

evidence.ai_binding: The atomic origin contains both Generated with Claude Code and Claude Co-Authored-By markers and directly creates every edge of the SSRF/error-oracle flow.
